categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: low-carbon papermaking (74.8%), producing linerboard and corrugating medium for corrugated boxes; green packaging (22.6%), manufacturing corrugated boards and boxes for various industries; and energy and resource recycling (2.6%), including waste paper procurement, public wastewater treatment, cogeneration, incineration, and related environmental engineering services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes five core environmental high-tech areas: recycled fiber utilization, energy-saving production, water-saving production, waste reuse, and space optimization. It employs advanced papermaking processes including pulping, refining, chemical addition, drying, and rewinding, alongside smart automation upgrades in packaging production lines. The firm also integrates cogeneration technology and environmental protection systems such as anaerobic wastewater treatment and solar power installations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers across various industries requiring packaging solutions, such as e-commerce, electronics, and agriculture. The company serves both domestic markets in Taiwan and mainland China, with a strong presence in Taiwan’s metropolitan areas and major economic zones in China’s Yangtze River Delta and Central China regions. The packaging products cater to industrial and consumer goods transportation and protection needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span Taiwan and mainland China, with manufacturing plants and packaging facilities located in Taiwan (e.g., Erlin, Longtan, Nankan) and multiple sites in China’s Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Hubei, Hunan, and Shanghai regions. The company also has investment and operational presence in Japan and the Cayman Islands, supporting its Asian market focus.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing base paper materials (linerboard and corrugating medium) and converting them into finished corrugated packaging products. It also manages upstream raw material sourcing through its own waste paper recycling stations, integrating vertically from raw material procurement to finished packaging solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing low-carbon papermaking and green packaging technologies, targeting net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. R&D focuses on enhancing recycled fiber utilization, energy and water efficiency, waste reduction, and smart manufacturing upgrades. The company invests significantly in product innovation, process optimization, and environmental sustainability to maintain competitive advantage and comply with tightening environmental regulations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of paperboard and corrugated packaging products. Additional income streams include energy sales from cogeneration facilities and environmental engineering services. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but focuses on manufacturing and direct sales to industrial and commercial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan’s corrugated paper market and ranks among the top four in China’s corrugated paper industry. It competes with other large-scale papermaking and packaging firms, leveraging its integrated supply chain, environmental technology leadership, and regional production capacity to maintain market share amid industry consolidation and environmental policy pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$47.8 billion, a 2.3% increase from the previous year, with operating profit improving significantly though net loss narrowed. The company operates with over 3,400 employees and has expanded production capacity to 4.2 million tons of low-carbon paper and 1.56 billion square meters of packaging annually. Growth is driven by capacity expansions in China and Taiwan, operational efficiency improvements, and market demand recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its commitment to sustainability, offering low-carbon, high-quality paper products and customized green packaging solutions. It integrates advanced environmental technologies and smart manufacturing to reduce carbon footprint and resource consumption. Its vertically integrated supply chain and regional production footprint enable responsive customer service and product innovation aligned with global environmental trends and customer needs.
